summary_en: Sapporo Beer will acquire up to 7.0 million shares (1.8% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of ¥10.0 billion via market purchase from November 12, 2026 through February 10, 2027, with all acquired shares to be canceled on March 10, 2027.
title_en: Notice of Decisions on Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
Sapporo Beer's board of directors has authorized the acquisition of up to 7.0 million shares of common stock, representing 1.8% of shares outstanding (excluding treasury stock), for a maximum aggregate price of ¥10.0 billion. The acquisition will be conducted through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 12, 2026 through February 10, 2027. All shares acquired under this authorization will be canceled effective March 10, 2027.

The company undertakes this program to improve capital efficiency by achieving an appropriate capital level, in line with the cash allocation policy set forth in its medium-term management plan 2027–2030. The reference data shows that as of September 30, 2026, the company held 3,999,080 treasury shares against 389,972,410 shares outstanding (excluding treasury stock).
